name: Midlothian
title: Midlothian —
title_em: Rosslyn, Roslin and the Pentland Hills.
tagline: Rosslyn Chapel, the home of Dolly the sheep and hills on Edinburgh's doorstep.
summary: Midlothian lies south of Edinburgh, between the city and the Moorfoot Hills. Rosslyn Chapel is a mysterious 15th-century church made famous by The Da Vinci Code.
The Roslin Institute produced Dolly the sheep, the first mammal cloned from an adult cell, in 1996.
